senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (चपति)
To caress, to coax, to soothe or console.
r. 10th cl. (चपयति)
To grind or pound.
(इ) चपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (चम्पति चम्पयति)
To go, to move.

m. (-पः)
1 A bow.
2 (In Geometry,) An arc or portion of a circle.
E.
चप to cast, (arrows,) affix घञ्.

m. (-टः)
The palm with extended fingers: see चपेट.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Trembling, tremulous, shaking.
2 Wavering, unsteady.
3 Inconsiderately criminal.
4 Swift, expeditious; (also in this sense, or swiftly, adv. n. -लं)
5 Momentary, instantaneous.
6 Agitated violently, overcome with alarm, &c.
m. (-लः)
1 Quicksilver.
2 A kind of stone.
3 A fish.
4 A thief.
f. (-ला)
1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ or fortune.
2 Lightning.
3 A whore.
4 Long pepper.
5 The tongue.
6 Spirituous liquor.
7 A species of the Aryā metre.
E.
चप to go, affix अलच्, or चुप to move, Uṇādi affix कल and the radical vowel changed.

n. (-लं)
1 Unsteadiness, (literally or metaphorically.)
2 Transitoriness.
E.
चपल trembling, अण् affix; also with यञ् affix चापल्य. n. (-ल्यं.)

f. (-ता)
1 Moving, trembling.
2 Fickleness, inconstancy.
E.
तल् added to the last, also with त्व, चपलत्वं.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Of a fickle or inconstant nature.
E.
चपल, आत्म self, and कन् added.

m. (-टः)
The palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
E.
चप to go, affix अच्, चप trembling, and इट् what goes or is, from इट् with क affix; also चपट and चर्पट.

m. (-तः)
A slap with the open hand.
E.
चपेट, and आघात a blow.

f. (-का)
A slap with the open hand.
E.
चपेट, and वुन् aff.

m. (-टः)
A tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) see प्रियाल.
E.
चाप a bow, and पट what goes.

n. (-यं)
Unsteadiness, transitoriness.
E.
चापल, and आश्रय support.
